description: Scarred and imposing, orcs possess an inner fire and relentless drive that allows them to push past any obstacle.

features.name: Darkvision
features.tldr: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light, and in darkness as if it were dim light.

features.name: Adrenaline Rush
features.tldr: You can take the Dash action as a bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest, gaining temporary hit points when you do.

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.tldr: When you are reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead once per long rest.

features.name: Orcish Lineage
features.tldr: Choose an orcish tribal heritage reflecting your physical specialization or culture.

features.name: Powerful Build
features.tldr: You count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift.

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.tldr: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time and add it to the extra damage.
